newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF Bank shares climb on takeover reports.
newsitem.headline: BHF Bank shares climb on takeover reports.

text.p: Shares in German bank BHF Bank climbed on Friday over 13 pct in early pre-bourse trading on talk the bank might be on the verge of being taken over by Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG.
In early pre-bourse trading the share price jumped 5.10 marks to 48.09 marks while the broader IBIS-DAX index was up 0.57 percent.

Earlier this morning German newspaper Boersen Zeitung said the bank was interested in taking a 75 percent stake in BHF Bank. Bankgesellschaft denied on Friday that it was currently in talks with BHF Bank or the bank's owners.
